title: Relaycast MCP Configuration
description: Configuration options for connecting to a Relaycast workspace.

relayApiKey.title: Workspace API Key
relayApiKey.description: Workspace API key (rk_live_...) used to pre-authenticate the MCP session. Optional — you can also authenticate via the set_workspace_key tool after connecting.

relayBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
relayBaseUrl.description: Override API base URL for self-hosted Relaycast deployments.
